record.original_question: For a compact Hermitian manifold (X, omega), define T(X, omega) as the infimum of integral_X (omega + dd^c phi)^n over smooth omega-plurisubharmonic functions phi. Determine whether T(X, omega) can be equal to 0 for some manifold.

evidence.quote: Question 30 (Tosatti). Let (X, omega) be a compact Hermitian manifold. Define T(X, omega) by T(X, omega) = inf { integral_X (omega + dd^c phi)^n | phi in C^infty(X) intersect PSH(X, omega) }. Is it possible that T(X, omega) = 0 for some manifold?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact complex Hermitian manifold of complex dimension $n$, where $\omega$ is a smooth positive $(1,1)$-form (not necessarily $d$-closed). Denote by $\mathrm{PSH}(X,\omega)$ the set of $\omega$-plurisubharmonic functions on $X$, i.e. upper semicontinuous functions $\varphi: X \to [-\infty,\infty)$, not identically $-\infty$, such that $\omega + dd^{c}\varphi \ge 0$ as a $(1,1)$-current, where $d^{c} = \tfrac{i}{2\pi}(\bar\partial - \partial)$ (so that $dd^{c} = \tfrac{i}{\pi}\partial\bar\partial$). Define
$$T(X,\omega) \;=\; \inf\Bigl\{\int_{X}(\omega + dd^{c}\varphi)^{n} \;:\; \varphi \in C^{\infty}(X)\cap \mathrm{PSH}(X,\omega)\Bigr\}.$$
Determine whether there exists a compact Hermitian manifold $(X,\omega)$ for which $T(X,\omega) = 0$, or whether $T(X,\omega) > 0$ for every compact Hermitian manifold.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is closely connected to the Kołodziej–Tosatti conjecture concerning Morse-type integrals/volumes of nef classes on compact Hermitian manifolds. Recent work (e.g. arXiv:2412.01586, 2024) establishes the conjecture only under an additional "bounded mass property" assumption, and earlier results handle special cases (semi-positive classes, dimension 2). No source verifies that $T(X,\omega)>0$ in general or produces an example with $T(X,\omega)=0$, so the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Kołodziej-Tosatti's conjecture on compact Hermitian manifold with bounded mass property
status_evidence.snippet: proves Kołodziej-Tosatti's conjecture under the bounded mass property; does not explicitly resolve whether T(X,ω) can vanish in general
status_evidence.claim: Only partial progress under additional assumptions; the general vanishing question is not settled.

status_evidence.title: Morse-type integrals on non-Kähler manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: partial answer to the conjecture on the volume of a nef class on a compact Hermitian manifold; true for semi-positive class and for any nef class in dimension 2
status_evidence.claim: Only partial results known on related volume/infimum questions for Hermitian manifolds.
